description: This file defines the SugarCacheWincache class, which extends the abstract SugarCacheAbstract class to implement caching functionalities using Windows Cache (Wincache) in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to determine if the backend cache should be used, and to set, get, clear, and reset cache entries via Wincache functions.

classes.name: SugarCacheWincache
classes.description: A class that implements caching operations using Windows Cache (Wincache) by extending the abstract SugarCacheAbstract class.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines whether to use Wincache as the caching backend based on the availability of Wincache functions and configuration settings.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Sets a cache value in Wincache for the specified key with an expiration timeout.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value from Wincache for the specified key, returning null if it does not exist.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry in Wincache for the provided key.
